en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5435 - Hammad ibn ʿIsa narrated from Ribʿi ibn Abdullah from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

regarding the testimony of a woman who was present when a man was making a will, and there was no man with her.
Imam (as) said: "Her testimony is accepted for one-fourth of the will."
